fact: The July 2024 CMA position paper directs banks in Eswatini, Lesotho, Namibia and South Africa to stop routing low-value cross-border EFTs through SADC-RTGS by 31 March 2027 and to use a retail scheme such as TCIB from 1 April 2027.
title: Position paper on the processing of cross-border low-value electronic fund transfers within the Common Monetary Area
publisher: Cross-border Payments Oversight Committee, Common Monetary Area (published by Central Bank of Eswatini)
